newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +1.75 pct vs mark/usd basket. [CORRECTED 11:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +1.75 pct vs mark/usd basket. [CORRECTED 11:20 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects percentage figure in headline and first paragraph to 1.75 pct from 1.68 pct)
The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 29.383 to the dollar after Monday's fixing at 28.943, and at 17.197 to the mark from 17.105.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +1.75 percent, down from Monday's +2.60.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +1.68 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
